provenance: Ten worked rows, not a sweep. Copy to chassis-seeds.json and fill until `seed_index.py --check` is clean. Splits name every class's subclass in parentheses, so a reader can rebuild the body. Keys are `<class file>/<### heading verbatim>` — take them from `--list`, never retype them. A candidate carries `builds`, keyed by niche: one subclass often has more than one honest expression, and they belong in different niches. Warlock/The Hexblade below is the case. The `src` / `seed_deps` / `score_deps` stamps are the cache key — written by `--stamp`, never by hand or by a sweep agent; those on this template are illustrative and will read as drifted once the class files move.

cleric/Heavy armour / martial weapon tab.why: A planning table that sits inside the Domains section, so it parses as a heading. The only one in 157.

front-line.why: Weapon domain that keeps full casting; Fighter 8 buys Action Surge, Brutish Durability and the off-cadence feat.

durability.why: The rescue ceiling in the list. Paladin 6 adds a pair-wide aura, which is why the split runs that deep.

skills.why: Expertise plus domain skills covers every gate, but nothing here scales into Act III and the damage never arrives.

cleric/Dream.why: Its best expression is the same Cleric 14 / Paladin 6 body; the domain changes the flavour of the healing, not the shape of the chassis.

front-line.why: Fighter 11 for the third attack, superiority dice on the short-rest clock, Rogue 9 for off-turn Sneak Attack into the second reaction.

reaction.why: Both reactions on manoeuvres and opportunity attacks; real only in a pair built to be attacked, which is why it is a separate build and not a variant.

lockdown.split: Blood Hunter 14 (Order of the Profane Soul) / Wizard 6 (Evocation)
lockdown.why: Int carries hemocraft and spell DCs at once, so one stat buys both halves.

front-line.why: Charisma to attack and damage, short-rest slots feeding smites, aura at Paladin 6.

short-rest.why: Same Charisma, different clock and role: Chains of Carceri and Quickened blast off pact slots rather than a weapon.

monk/Way of the Four Elements (vanilla).why: Every ki option is flat dice with no upcast path, so it decays against Combat Extender's +126% regular and +170% boss HP. No 20-level split fixes the scaling.

action-economy.why: Hands actions to the partner rather than taking more itself, which is the half of the Actions axis a duo actually lacks.
